description: Nine smartphone motion-sensor recordings used to study structural breaks in variance. A person, a motorbike, and a car were recorded with a G-Force Meter, gyroscope, and/or linear accelerometer via Physics Toolbox Sensor Suite. Observer-declared change-point intervals are included.
acquisition_method: Smartphone running Physics Toolbox Sensor Suite (Android). G-Force Meter (±4 g, up to 100 Hz), linear accelerometer (up to 100 Hz), gyroscope (±17.45 rad/s, up to 100 Hz). Observer noted when the character of the vibrations changed.

temporal_coverage.time_column: time_s (elapsed seconds from recording start; not calendar time)

spatial_coverage: Urban route with cobblestone (sett) and asphalt segments (vehicle recordings); pedestrian gait recordings. Exact landmarks are not published.

sources.citation: Witulska, J., & Wyłomańska, A. (2022). Identification of the structure break point for data with changing variance. Mathematica Applicanda, 50(1), 65–106.
